integrity.asserted_scope: analytical theorem with finite numerical diagnostics; neither independent certification nor universal priority is claimed

scientific_limitations: Stationary equal-time samples of noninteracting particles with one shared two-state positive-stiffness trap; time-series data are not considered.

The generic one-half logarithmic information growth is already predicted by general Bayesian-information theory; the claimed model-specific content is the exact finite-size identity and weak-contrast crossover.
Moving-contrast results require rates scaled to hold two stationary beta-shape parameters fixed; other scalings are not claimed.
Independent literature-priority comparison and audit have not been performed.
title: Information sharing and the weak-contrast threshold in a switching harmonic gas
